inlines.v: DELIGHTFULLY, adverb 1. In a manner to receive great pleasure; very agreeable; as, we were delightfully employed, or entertained. 2. In a delightful manner; charmingly; in a manner to afford great pleasure; as, the lady sings and plays delightfully
